_comment: Frozen cross-implementation golden vector for the multihop proof-of-possession (PoP) signed message. The PoP preimage is deterministic raw concatenation: context || exit_id (16) || encapsulated_key (32). The Ed25519 signature itself is RFC 8032 (deterministic), so a sibling SDK reproduces it from its own Ed25519; this vector pins the Warren-specific preimage and the signing-key seed so the whole chain is replayable. Versioned with the control wire (/v2): a layout change mints a new context, never mutates this one.

vectors._comment: exit_id all 0xaa, encapsulated_key all 0x5c. preimage = context || exit_id || encap. signing_key_seed is the raw 32-byte Ed25519 seed used to mint the pinned signature.
